_critical_intervention_flag: Thurrock is under LIVE government Best Value intervention with COMMISSIONERS (since 2 Sept 2022, to at least 30 April 2028). Lead Commissioner Gavin Jones CBE; Finance Commissioner Denise Murray; Managing Director Commissioner Dr Dave Smith does the Chief Executive role. ~GBP 1.5bn debt; S114 Dec 2022; Capitalisation Direction GBP 638m; EFS ~GBP 72.1m for 2026/27. Every executive decision is subject to commissioner oversight.
_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set 26 Feb 2026 under commissioner oversight. Reform UK won 7 May 2026 and inherits delivery under continuing intervention; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (45 of 49). Leader Cllr Richard Bingley. The council remains under government commissioners; the Cabinet operates within the Best Value intervention. A unitary authority.
